name: html-product-grid-catalog-image-without-cart
description: Emits an html_product_grid_fallback for a browse/marketplace catalog grid whose cards carry a name, a one-time price, and a per-card photo but no add-to-cart control and no schema.org markup -- the purchase action lives on a detail page, not the grid card. Requires at least four such image-corroborated cards before trusting the weaker signal.

source_reference.notes: Real-world marketplace/browse grids (captured evidence: a logo marketplace catalog page) commonly show name + price + photo per card with the buy action on a separate detail page, so no cart-control token appears on the grid card itself. CommerceStructureRecognizer::productCardData() qualifies this structural quad (name + one-time price + image) without a cart control, and CommerceFallbackReporter requires >= 4 such image-only-qualified cards in one grid before emitting a finding, since a small (2-3 card) count is a far more common false positive (e.g. a pricing/plan comparison) than a real catalog is.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream commerce-recognition fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
